findings.title: European innovation scoreboard 2026
findings.abstract_or_evidence: The European Innovation Scoreboard 2026 compares innovation systems in the EU, other European economies and global comparators. It measures 32 indicators across four dimensions, using Eurostat and other international statistical sources. The report is comparative innovation-system monitoring evidence, not causal evaluation of individual policies.
principal_findings: The 2026 edition evaluates the EU, 27 member states, 13 neighbouring European countries and 11 global competitors.
Its 32 indicators are grouped into four dimensions and draw on Eurostat and other international statistics.
This is comparative system-level R&I benchmarking; country rankings should not be interpreted as causally attributable to individual policy interventions.
findings.eu_ri_relevance: Direct official evidence about European research and innovation performance, capability benchmarking and cross-economy comparison of innovation systems.
evidence_quotes: The EIS provides a comparative analysis of the innovation performance
national innovation system performance is based on a set of 32 indicators
